topic: How does the polarization preservation fidelity of satellite-to-ground optical links influence continuous variable quantum key distribution protocol selection?
consensus_response: Polarization preservation fidelity significantly affects CV-QKD protocol selection due to its influence on channel loss and background noise. Higher polarization preservation fidelity reduces channel loss, allowing for more efficient key distribution. Conversely, lower fidelity increases background noise, compromising key rates. This trade-off necessitates careful consideration of polarization effects when selecting a CV-QKD protocol for satellite-based quantum communication. Optimizing polarization preservation fidelity requires balancing PMD effects with other factors in CV-QKD protocol selection.
